recipes.description_en: Austrian fluffy shredded pancake with raisins and powdered sugar.
recipes.description_it: Frittata dolce austriaca soffice, spezzettata con uvetta e zucchero a velo.

steps.en: Separate eggs; whisk yolks with milk and flour and fold in beaten whites and raisins.
steps.it: Separa le uova; mescola tuorli con latte e farina e incorpora albumi montati e uvetta.

steps.en: Pour into a buttered pan and cook gently until set underneath; flip in sections.
steps.it: Versa in padella imburrata e cuoci dolcemente fino a base rassodata; gira a pezzi.

steps.en: Tear into bite-size pieces, lightly caramelize with butter and sugar and dust with powdered sugar.
steps.it: Spezza in bocconi, caramella leggermente con burro e zucchero e spolvera di zucchero a velo.

recipes.description_en: Polish dumplings filled with potatoes, fresh cheese and onions.
recipes.description_it: Ravioli polacchi ripieni di patate, formaggio fresco e cipolle.

steps.en: Mix flour and warm water into a pliable dough and rest covered.
steps.it: Impasta farina e acqua tiepida fino a pasta elastica e riposa coperto.

steps.en: Mash boiled potatoes with quark and browned onion; roll dough and cut circles.
steps.it: Schiaccia patate lessate con quark e cipolla dorata; stendi la pasta e ritaglia cerchi.

steps.en: Fill, seal and boil pierogi until they float and cook through; toss with butter and onion.
steps.it: Farcisci, chiudi e lessa i pierogi finché galleggiano e cuociono; condisci con burro e cipolla.

recipes.description_en: Polish clear beetroot broth with a gently tart finish.
recipes.description_it: Brodo polacco limpido di barbabietola dal gusto delicatamente acidulo.

steps.en: Peel and slice beets and carrots; soften onion and garlic lightly in a pot.
steps.it: Pela e affetta barbabietole e carote; fai appassire leggermente cipolla e aglio in pentola.

steps.en: Add stock, beets, bay and pepper and simmer until vegetables are tender.
steps.it: Aggiungi brodo, barbabietole, alloro e pepe e cuoci fino a verdure tenere.

steps.en: Strain for a clear soup or keep pieces; add vinegar gradually and serve warm.
steps.it: Filtra per brodo limpido o lascia le verdure; aggiungi aceto gradualmente e servi caldo.

recipes.description_en: Ukrainian beet, cabbage and beef soup served with sour cream.
recipes.description_it: Zuppa ucraina di barbabietola, cavolo e manzo con panna acida.

steps.en: Simmer beef in water or stock until tender; skim foam as needed.
steps.it: Cuoci il manzo in acqua o brodo fino a tenerezza; elimina la schiuma.

steps.en: Cook chopped beetroot, cabbage, potato, carrots and onion with tomato paste in the broth until soft.
steps.it: Cuoci barbabietole, cavolo, patate, carote e cipolla tritate con concentrato nel brodo fino a morbidezza.

steps.en: Season, rest briefly and serve with sour cream and dill.
steps.it: Condisci, riposa brevemente e servi con panna acida e aneto.

recipes.description_en: Ukrainian fruit dumplings with cherries and a light sweet filling.
recipes.description_it: Ravioli dolci ucraini alle ciliegie con ripieno leggermente zuccherato.

steps.en: Knead flour and warm water into smooth dough, cover and rest 20 minutes.
steps.it: Impasta farina e acqua tiepida fino a pasta liscia, copri e riposa 20 minuti.

steps.en: Pit cherries and mix with sugar; roll dough thin and cut small circles.
steps.it: Snocciola le ciliegie e mescola con zucchero; stendi sottile e ritaglia dischi.

steps.en: Fill, seal securely and simmer in gently boiling water until dough is tender; serve with butter and sour cream.
steps.it: Farcisci, sigilla e lessa a leggero bollore fino a pasta cotta; servi con burro e panna acida.

recipes.description_en: Hungarian paprika-rich beef stew with potatoes and caraway.
recipes.description_it: Stufato ungherese di manzo con paprica, patate e carvi.

steps.en: Brown diced beef with onion; briefly bloom sweet paprika off direct heat to avoid burning.
steps.it: Rosola manzo a cubetti e cipolla; fuori dal fuoco fai profumare brevemente la paprica senza bruciarla.

steps.en: Add tomatoes, stock and caraway and simmer covered until beef is nearly tender.
steps.it: Unisci pomodori, brodo e carvi e stufa coperto finché il manzo è quasi tenero.

steps.en: Add potatoes and carrots and simmer until everything is soft and the sauce is rich.
steps.it: Aggiungi patate e carote e cuoci fino a verdure morbide e salsa ricca.

recipes.description_en: Hungarian fried flatbread traditionally served with garlic and sour cream; cheese variation.
recipes.description_it: Focaccia ungherese fritta con aglio e panna acida; variante al formaggio.

steps.en: Mix flour, warm milk, yeast, sugar and water as needed into soft dough; let rise until doubled.
steps.it: Impasta farina, latte tiepido, lievito, zucchero e acqua quanto basta; lascia lievitare fino al raddoppio.

steps.en: Stretch small rounds with oiled hands and fry until both sides are golden.
steps.it: Allarga dischi con mani unte e friggi fino a doratura dei due lati.

steps.en: Drain and brush with crushed garlic, then add sour cream and grated cheese.
steps.it: Scola, spennella con aglio schiacciato e aggiungi panna acida e formaggio grattugiato.

recipes.description_en: Dalmatian-style chard and potatoes with garlic and olive oil.
recipes.description_it: Bietole e patate in stile dalmata con aglio e olio.

steps.en: Peel and dice potatoes and boil until tender.
steps.it: Pela e taglia le patate a dadini e lessale fino a morbidezza.

steps.en: Add chopped chard to the pot for the last few minutes; drain thoroughly.
steps.it: Aggiungi bietole tritate negli ultimi minuti; scola molto bene.

steps.en: Warm sliced garlic in olive oil, toss with potatoes and greens and finish with lemon.
steps.it: Scalda aglio a fette nell’olio, condisci patate e verdure e completa con limone.

recipes.description_en: Dalmatian slow-cooked beef with wine, prunes and a sweet-tart sauce.
recipes.description_it: Manzo dalmata a lunga cottura con vino, prugne e salsa agrodolce.

steps.en: Marinate beef chilled with wine, vinegar and aromatics if time allows; pat dry.
steps.it: Marina il manzo in frigo con vino, aceto e aromi se possibile; asciuga.

steps.en: Brown beef, add onions, carrots, tomato paste, marinade and prunes and braise gently until very tender.
steps.it: Rosola la carne, aggiungi cipolle, carote, concentrato, marinata e prugne e stufa dolcemente fino a tenerezza.

steps.en: Slice meat and reduce the cooking sauce; serve over gnocchi or polenta.
steps.it: Affetta la carne e riduci la salsa; servi su gnocchi o polenta.

recipes.description_en: Swedish-style small meatballs in creamy gravy.
recipes.description_it: Polpettine in stile svedese con salsa cremosa.

steps.en: Soak breadcrumbs in milk, mix with mince, grated onion and egg and shape small balls.
steps.it: Ammolla pangrattato nel latte, unisci macinato, cipolla grattugiata e uovo e forma palline.

steps.en: Brown meatballs in butter, then finish cooking until they reach 71°C inside.
steps.it: Rosola le polpettine nel burro, poi porta a cottura fino a 71 °C al centro.

steps.en: Add stock and cream to the pan juices and simmer into gravy; return meatballs to coat.
steps.it: Aggiungi brodo e panna ai succhi e riduci in salsa; rimetti le polpette per condirle.

recipes.description_en: Swedish soft cinnamon buns with cardamom-scented dough.
recipes.description_it: Girelle svedesi alla cannella con impasto profumato al cardamomo.

steps.en: Knead flour, warm milk, yeast, some butter, sugar and cardamom into soft dough; rise until doubled.
steps.it: Impasta farina, latte tiepido, lievito, parte del burro, zucchero e cardamomo; lievita al raddoppio.

steps.en: Roll dough, spread with remaining butter, cinnamon and sugar, then roll and cut buns.
steps.it: Stendi, spalma burro restante con cannella e zucchero, arrotola e taglia le girelle.

steps.en: Proof again, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200°C for 12–16 minutes until golden.
steps.it: Fai lievitare ancora, spennella con uovo e cuoci a 200 °C per 12–16 minuti fino a doratura.

recipes.description_en: Irish mashed potatoes with cabbage and spring onions.
recipes.description_it: Purè irlandese di patate con verza e cipollotti.

steps.en: Boil potatoes until very tender and mash smooth with warm milk and butter.
steps.it: Lessa le patate fino a morbidezza e schiacciale con latte caldo e burro.

steps.en: Cook finely shredded cabbage in a little water until soft and drain well.
steps.it: Cuoci la verza affettata sottilmente in poca acqua fino a morbidezza e scola bene.

steps.en: Fold cabbage and sliced spring onions into mash and serve warm.
steps.it: Incorpora verza e cipollotti affettati al purè e servi caldo.

recipes.description_en: British lamb and vegetable bake topped with browned mashed potatoes.
recipes.description_it: Sformato britannico di agnello e verdure coperto con purè dorato.

steps.en: Brown lamb with onion and carrots; add peas, stock and tomato paste and reduce until thick.
steps.it: Rosola agnello con cipolla e carote; unisci piselli, brodo e concentrato e restringi.

steps.en: Boil potatoes and mash with butter and milk.
steps.it: Lessa le patate e schiacciale con burro e latte.

steps.en: Spread filling in a dish, cover with mashed potatoes, score the top and bake at 200°C for 25 minutes.
steps.it: Distribuisci il ripieno in teglia, copri con purè, incidi la superficie e cuoci a 200 °C per 25 minuti.

recipes.description_en: British tea-time scones, lightly sweet and tender.
recipes.description_it: Scones britannici da tè, leggermente dolci e morbidi.

steps.en: Rub cold butter into self-raising flour, then stir in sugar and milk to make a soft dough.
steps.it: Sfrega burro freddo nella farina autolievitante, poi unisci zucchero e latte fino a impasto morbido.

steps.en: Pat dough 2.5 cm thick and cut rounds without twisting the cutter.
steps.it: Appiattisci a 2,5 cm e ritaglia dischi senza ruotare il tagliapasta.

steps.en: Brush with beaten egg and bake at 210°C for 12–15 minutes until risen and golden.
steps.it: Spennella con uovo sbattuto e cuoci a 210 °C per 12–15 minuti fino a gonfi e dorati.

recipes.description_en: Dutch mashed potatoes combined with kale and mustard.
recipes.description_it: Purè olandese di patate con cavolo riccio e senape.

steps.en: Boil diced potatoes in lightly salted water until almost soft.
steps.it: Lessa le patate a pezzi in acqua poco salata fin quasi a morbidezza.

steps.en: Add chopped kale and cook until tender; drain well.
steps.it: Unisci cavolo riccio tritato e cuoci fino a tenerezza; scola bene.

steps.en: Mash with butter, warm milk and mustard and serve immediately.
steps.it: Schiaccia con burro, latte caldo e senape e servi subito.

recipes.description_en: Belgian beef stew slowly braised with beer, onions and mustard.
recipes.description_it: Stufato belga di manzo brasato lentamente con birra, cipolle e senape.

steps.en: Brown beef in butter; soften sliced onions in the same pot.
steps.it: Rosola il manzo nel burro; fai appassire le cipolle affettate nella stessa pentola.

steps.en: Return beef, add beer, thyme and sugar, and lay mustard-spread bread over the surface.
steps.it: Rimetti la carne, aggiungi birra, timo e zucchero e appoggia pane spalmato di senape sopra.

steps.en: Cover and simmer gently for around 2½ hours until the meat is tender and bread dissolves into the sauce.
steps.it: Copri e stufa dolcemente circa due ore e mezza finché carne tenera e pane sciolto nella salsa.

recipes.description_en: Romanian cabbage rolls with pork and rice in a tomato-rich braise.
recipes.description_it: Involtini rumeni di cavolo con maiale e riso, brasati al pomodoro.

steps.en: Rinse sauerkraut leaves if very salty; mix pork, rinsed rice, chopped onion and paprika.
steps.it: Sciacqua le foglie di crauti se molto salate; mescola maiale, riso sciacquato, cipolla e paprica.

steps.en: Wrap small portions in leaves and pack closely in a pot with extra cabbage.
steps.it: Avvolgi piccole porzioni nelle foglie e disponi strette in pentola con cavolo extra.

steps.en: Add tomato sauce and water, cover and simmer for 1½–2 hours until rice and pork are fully cooked.
steps.it: Aggiungi pomodoro e acqua, copri e stufa 1½–2 ore finché riso e maiale sono completamente cotti.

recipes.description_en: Czech creamy mushroom and potato soup with dill and eggs.
recipes.description_it: Zuppa ceca cremosa di funghi e patate con aneto e uova.

steps.en: Sauté mushrooms in butter; add stock and diced potatoes and simmer until tender.
steps.it: Salta i funghi nel burro; aggiungi brodo e patate a cubetti e cuoci fino a morbidezza.

steps.en: Whisk sour cream with a little hot broth, then stir back into soup without hard boiling.
steps.it: Stempera la panna acida con poco brodo caldo, poi incorporala senza bollire forte.

steps.en: Add dill and vinegar to taste; top each bowl with a fully cooked or safely prepared egg.
steps.it: Unisci aneto e aceto a piacere; completa ogni ciotola con uovo ben cotto o preparato in sicurezza.

recipes.description_en: Swiss crisp potato cake with a tender center.
recipes.description_it: Torta svizzera di patate croccante fuori e morbida dentro.

steps.en: Coarsely grate peeled potatoes and squeeze out excess moisture.
steps.it: Grattugia grossolanamente le patate pelate e strizzale per eliminare l’acqua.

steps.en: Heat butter in a wide nonstick pan, press potatoes into a cake and cook gently until golden underneath.
steps.it: Scalda il burro in padella antiaderente, compatta le patate a tortino e cuoci dolcemente fino a base dorata.

steps.en: Invert carefully with a plate, cook the other side until crisp and serve immediately.
steps.it: Capovolgi con un piatto, dora l’altro lato e servi subito.

recipes.description_en: Danish pan-fried pork patties with onion and a tender interior.
recipes.description_it: Polpette danesi di maiale cotte in padella con cipolla, morbide all’interno.

steps.en: Combine minced pork with grated onion, egg, flour and milk; chill mixture briefly.
steps.it: Mescola maiale macinato con cipolla grattugiata, uovo, farina e latte; raffredda brevemente.

steps.en: Shape oval patties with a spoon and brown in butter over medium heat.
steps.it: Forma polpette ovali col cucchiaio e rosolale nel burro a fuoco medio.

steps.en: Turn and cook through until the center reaches a safe temperature; rest briefly before serving.
steps.it: Gira e cuoci bene al centro fino a temperatura sicura; riposa brevemente prima di servire.

recipes.description_en: Norwegian white-fish cakes with mild seasoning and a tender texture.
recipes.description_it: Polpette norvegesi di pesce bianco dal gusto delicato e consistenza morbida.

steps.en: Chop chilled cod and blend briefly with egg, starch, milk and grated onion.
steps.it: Trita il merluzzo freddo e frulla brevemente con uovo, fecola, latte e cipolla grattugiata.

steps.en: Shape fish cakes with wet hands and chill for 10 minutes.
steps.it: Forma polpette con mani bagnate e riposa in frigo 10 minuti.

steps.en: Pan-fry gently in butter until golden and cooked through; finish with dill.
steps.it: Cuoci dolcemente nel burro fino a doratura e completa cottura; completa con aneto.
